differential.name: Diabetic nephropathy progression
differential.rationale: Long‑standing type 2 diabetes with proteinuria/microalbuminuria drives CKD worsening.

differential.name: Secondary hyperparathyroidism (renal osteodystrophy)
differential.rationale: CKD stage 4‑5 commonly leads to calcium‑phosphate imbalance and bone pain.
